courses.name: Lab Human-Centered Sensing and Digital Health
courses.professor: Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Björn-Peter Krüger
courses.group: Personalized Digital Health and Telemedicine (Uni Bonn, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences / University Hospital Bonn, Dept. of Epileptology; Institute of Computer Science, Department VIII 'Computational Life & Health')
courses.contents: Practical lab on human-centered sensing and digital health offered by the Personalized Digital Health and Telemedicine group of Prof. Björn Krüger. The group's focus is sensor-based acquisition and analysis of human data - wearables for health monitoring (e.g. epileptic seizure detection), contactless measurement of posture, movement and vital signs from video/depth/thermal cameras, and AI-based analysis and visualization of this data with attention to privacy of health data. Per BASIS (WS 2026/27): 4 SWS, English, organizational intro meeting 06.10.2026 via Zoom; supervised by group members Anna Jansen, Melissa Steininger and Nazila Ahmadi Daryakenari.
